verdict.rationale: AI Gateway supports dynamic routing (conditions, quotas, A/B/gradual rollouts, segment-based routing) and fallback chains across providers/models with sequential retry-on-error, but the evidence describes rule-based/conditional routing and ordered fallback sequences rather than true weighted, latency-based, or cost-based load balancing across providers/keys. missing for 10: explicit weighted traffic splitting, latency-based routing decisions, cost-based routing logic, and any independent/hands-on verification of these mechanisms.
